name: Mew
notes: Painted design: an almost flat pale pink with only faint soft smudges (a few texels, random directions) and very soft occlusion; thin grey-mauve toe lines on the feet; one orange pad oval.

So: very short, fine fur that reads almost smooth: strands 2.5 texels, flow from the geometry, very low relief and almost no albedo change (Mew must keep its soft velvety look); the faint painted smudges stay as they are. Toe lines and pad untouched.
Body shader has no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load (baked cavity kept tiny).
